summary: A LaSalle Parish tower in the community of Little Creek that Wikipedia's list of Louisiana towers marks torn down; no build or removal date is given.

facts.status_note: Listed as torn down; the list gives no removal date.

events.note: Last labeled on a USGS map, per the Wikipedia list. This is a map date, not a removal date.

evidence.supports: first steel fire tower near Bogalusa, 1922
evidence.quote: In 1922 the first steel fire tower was built near Bogalusa on Great Southern Lumber Company land.
By 1943 thirty-nine fire towers had been built and by 1950 the number had increased to fifty-six.

notes_for_editor: Single source: a Wikipedia list. Its torn-down status rests on a 2012 USGS map label and a check of 1998 aerial imagery, not on a dated record of removal. A name variant, Bay Springs Lookout Tower, appears on an Anyplace America topo page (auto-generated, not used) and on a Pastmaps page about old maps (not used). The cached USGS domestic-names file for Louisiana has no entry under either name, so the tower could not be checked there. No photos found. Confidence low.
